subject: CrescentCare — sales to CS handoff and go‑live expectations

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Clarke <emma@crescentcare.com>, Rajiv Singh <rajiv@crescentcare.com>
Date: 2027-06-27T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: CrescentCare — handoff + upfront expectations

Hi team,

Quick handoff for CrescentCare (closed earlier today). Summary: 12‑month commercial contract, $150k ARR, primary use is conversational triage + embeddings for patient portal search. Go‑live target: 2027‑07‑18 (customer expects pilot in staging by 7/11).

Key scope items for CS/delivery:
- Models: open‑weight LLaMA‑based encoder + chat variant (we shipped model artifact list to Emma).
- Environments: dev/staging/prod (customer requests private VPC for prod).
- Data: PII will be pseudonymized on their side; they want retention controls and audit logging.
- Integrations: SAML SSO and API access to patient records (read only) — see tech contact Rajiv.

Attachments: CrescentCare_SOW_v1.pdf, CrescentCare_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN.xlsx (mutual action plan includes milestones + acceptance criteria).

Asks for CS: please confirm primary owner, a 60‑min kickoff slot next week, and any pre‑kickoff artifacts you need. I will keep supporting procurement and stakeholder intro until kickoff is locked.

Internal note: Procurement loop (Rajiv) will have redlines around data residency and SLA. Monica — can you run a security preflight checklist ASAP so we can surface any blockers?

Thanks — Neha
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Thanks Neha — congrats to the team. Looping in delivery and security.

Tessa — can you take primary delivery ownership? Specifically:
- Confirm readiness of the staging environment (target: populated by 7/08).
- Lead the 60‑min kickoff and own the draft runbook for the pilot.

Monica — please start the SOC2/security preflight and confirm whether a VPC private deployment is needed for initial pilot or only prod.

Emma/Rajiv — we'll propose 3 kickoff windows from the CS side; please flag any blackout dates. For transparency, I CC'd procurement.
